DIAGNOSIS READY: Kennedy's Disease (Spinal and Bulbar Muscular Atrophy).

The clinical presentation of a 54-year-old male with progressive gait instability, urinary incontinence, and recent bulbar symptoms (speech slurring) is highly characteristic of Kennedy's disease, an X-linked recessive disorder affecting motor neurons.
